lines.hello: Ah! You're awake! You gave me quite a turn, lying there on the sand like that.
lines.welcome: Welcome to Hisui, a wild land at the edge of the known world!
lines.myName: I'm Laventon, a professor of Pokémon. I came to Hisui with the Galaxy Team to study the creatures that live here.
lines.world: Pokémon roam everywhere in this land: the fields, the bogs, the coasts, the highlands and the frozen north.
lines.oneOfThem: This little one is one of my three companions. Do try not to frighten it!
lines.liveAlongside: Most people here still fear Pokémon. Few have ever stood beside one, let alone called one a friend.
lines.study: I mean to change that, by learning all I can about them and writing it down in the very first Pokédex.
lines.enough: But listen to me ramble on! Tell me about yourself.
lines.boyOrGirl: Are you a boy, or are you a girl?
lines.nextDoor: The Galaxy Team has young members your age. One of them in particular is sure to take you under their wing.
lines.neverStill: They walk the wilds every day, and they never seem to tire.
lines.ofCourse: I have a feeling the two of you will get along famously.
lines.story: {name}, your story in Hisui begins on Prelude Beach, just below the Galaxy Team's village.
